title: Affine bottom model on a universally free degree-zero locus
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and K a perfect object [def-pc-perfect-complex] of D(O_S) [def-pc-derived-category]. Suppose every derived pullback Lk*K [def-pc-derived-pullback] has zero cohomology in every negative degree. Suppose each point of S has an open U0 and an integer r >= 0 such that H0(L(k >> U0.ι)*K) is finite locally free of rank r [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module] for every scheme Y and k:Y -> U0. For every point s of S there is an affine open U containing s and a strictly perfect complex B on its localized ringed site [def-pur-localized-ringed-site], with B^i zero for i < 0 and B.d(0,1)=0, together with a derived isomorphism K|U -> Q(B). No source module or arrow is specified.

source.place: Tag 0BDL, proof on the rank-r matrix charts; Tag 0BCD, residue-rank model; Tag 0EWY, square injective free map

proof.text: Evaluate hnegative at the residue morphism of s. Evaluation of a zero cohomology sheaf gives a subsingleton vector space, so every negative derivedFiberBetti is zero. Apply the finite-free residue model at s to obtain bounded terms freely generated by the Betti numbers.

Choose U0 and r from hloc at s. Factor the residue morphism through U0. Its H0 is rank-r locally free on the spectrum of a field, hence free of rank r on the whole one-point scheme. The existing free-section dimension formula, with an explicit scalar-compatible identity linear equivalence, gives derivedFiberBetti S K 0 s = r. The identity test on U0 and the derived open-pullback homology comparison show that H0(K) restricted to U0 is locally free of rank r. Choose a trivializing member containing s, transfer its restriction through the isomorphism onto its image in S, then choose an affine open inside its intersection with the residue-model chart. Exact overMap restriction preserves the bounds and all free term ranks; overFunctorMap and mapDerivedCategoryFactors transport the representing derived isomorphism. Exact restriction commutes with homology, so the new model has a free rank-r H0.

Convert each negative free term to the zero-rank free sheaf using its zero Betti number, and prove this sheaf is zero by the freeHomEquiv universal property and Fin.elim0. The given free term isomorphisms split each term off a finite free sheaf, proving strict perfectness with the preserved bounds.

The incoming differential is zero since its source term in degree -1 is zero. The canonical pOpcycles isomorphism gives a monomorphism H0(B) -> B.X 0 whose composite with d0 is zero. Transfer this inclusion and d0 through the open-site equivalence and the three free trivializations. On global sections the inclusion is multiplication by an injective square matrix A. Matrix.mulVec_injective_iff, Matrix.linearIndependent_col_iff_row and Matrix.vecMul_injective_iff give injectivity of row multiplication by A. Applying the zero-composite equation to every standard basis vector shows every row of the outgoing matrix annihilates A. Each row is therefore zero. The outgoing sheaf map is zero because free sheaves are generated by their global basis sections; the proof checks the unit maps on top and propagates their zero value using naturality and linearity. Faithfulness of the open-site equivalence yields B.d 0 1 = 0. Combine the affine neighbourhood, strict perfectness, negative vanishing, zero differential and derived isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Matrix-chart proof, using Tags 0BCD and 0EWY; exact open restriction and its homology comparison. All chart refinement and square-matrix glue proved in Lean with private helpers.

lean.statement: theorem perfect_universalH0_bottom_model [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] (S : Scheme.{u}) [∀ U : S.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U))] (K : schemeDerivedCategory S) (hK : IsPerfect S K) (hnegative : ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (k : Y ⟶ S) (i : ℤ), i < 0 → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) i).obj ((derivedPullback k).obj K))) (hloc : ∀ s : S, ∃ U : S.Opens, s ∈ U ∧ ∃ r : ℕ, ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (k : Y ⟶ U.toScheme), SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank.{u, u, u} ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj ((derivedPullback (k ≫ U.ι)).obj K)) r) (s : S) : ∃ U : S.Opens, s ∈ U ∧ IsAffineOpen U ∧ ∃ B : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings S.toRingedSpace).over U)) ℤ, IsStrictlyPerfect S U B ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 → IsZero (B.X i)) ∧ B.d 0 1 = 0 ∧ Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.obj K ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj B)
